properties.name: -winui-based-on
properties.description: The WinUI Style this rule is based on (a key such as BodyTextBlockStyle): the rule's declarations are set on top of it.

properties.name: -winui-elevation
properties.description: The depth of the element's ThemeShadow, in px: a WinUI shadow that follows the theme. It has no colour, offset or blur; -winui-shadow: composition draws box-shadow with those. Units: Native, as written: px, deg, s, ms, fr. No WinUI equivalent (an error that says what to write): rem, em, ch, ex, cap, ic, lh, rlh, rch, rex, rcap, ric, pt, pc, in, cm, mm, q, vw, vh, vmin, vmax, vi, vb, svw, svh, svi, svb, lvw, lvh, lvi, lvb, dvw, dvh, dvi, dvb, cqw, cqh, cqi, cqb, cqmin, cqmax, rad, grad, turn, dppx, dpi, dpcm, x, %.

properties.name: -winui-shadow
properties.description: How box-shadow is drawn: theme (the default) is a ThemeShadow whose depth is the blur; composition is a Composition DropShadow that keeps the colour, x and y offset, blur and spread (not inset), cut out under the element.

properties.name: -winui-shadow-receiver
properties.description: Makes the element a receiver of the ThemeShadows whose elements name the same group in -winui-shadow-cast-on (before Windows 11 a ThemeShadow draws only on its receivers).

properties.name: -winui-shadow-cast-on
properties.description: Sets the Receivers of the element's ThemeShadow (set by -winui-elevation) to the elements that name the same group in -winui-shadow-receiver.

properties.name: animation-timeline
properties.description: WinUI: links an animation to a scroll viewer through Composition. Values: auto, none, scroll([nearest | root | self] [block | inline | x | y]), view([axis] [inset]) or a name a scroll-timeline-name or view-timeline-name gave. It drives opacity, translate, scale and rotate only, straight (animation-timing-function: linear).

properties.name: animation-range
properties.description: WinUI: the part of a scroll or view timeline the animation spans. normal, a length in px or a percentage; a view timeline also takes cover, contain, entry, exit, entry-crossing and exit-crossing with an offset.
